title: QR Font Treasure Trail
oneLiner: A printable party and venue toy that turns plain text into no-image QR clue trails for cafes, classrooms, and popups.
targetUser: Cafe owners, teachers, event hosts, and makers who want a low-tech interactive trail without building an app or printing image assets.
keyUx: Write clues, convert them into font-based QR cards, arrange a route, test scan order, and export printable cards plus a completion stamp.
stitchPrompt: Create a playful printable web app called “QR Font Treasure Trail” for cafes, classrooms, and popup hosts making no-image QR clue trails. Show a clue text stack, font QR card preview, trail route board, scan-order tester, prize stamp, printable card sheet, and venue setup checklist. Design direction: use the playful-experimental profile with bright print-shop energy, tactile card previews, bold scan states, and a clear export-to-print workflow.
